about_the_game:
Available in Q2 2025


In this DLC, you’ll become a cleaning specialist, armed with a pressure washer to restore order to the prison walls. Mysterious stains, mold, graffiti – 17 unique locations await, including:

  • Death Row – because the last moments should be in a hygienic setting.
  • Execution Room – starting off with a blast… literally!
  • Cafeteria & Kitchen – you'd rather not ask where those stains come from.
  • Showers – what happens here… stays here.


Your tools:
  • A pressure washer with four different nozzles.
  • A progress bar so you know how close you are to spotless perfection.
  • A relaxing game mode – no daily prison duties, just the satisfaction of cleaning.
  • New Steam achievements, because someone should recognize your hard work!

Guards and inmates may complain, but a clean prison is a better prison.
Grab your pressure washer and get to work – this mess won’t clean itself!

name: Prison Simulator: Power Wash
short_description: Grab your pressure washer and clean 17 filthy prison locations! Scrub cells, the cafeteria, showers, and even the execution room. Use four different nozzles, track your progress, and earn new achievements. A clean prison is a good prison… right?
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Polish, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Turkish, Portuguese - Brazil, Czech, Spanish - Latin America, Dutch, Romanian, Thai, Ukrainian, Hungarian
